title: Add MultipartFileArgumentResolver for HTTP interface client

timeline.author: Olga Maciaszek-Sharma

timeline.body: You can pass the name as `""`. It's checked later on in the base class and updated.
We can avoid parsing here, and use `headers.addHeader(HttpHeaders.CONTENT_TYPE, file.getContentType())`.
`Assert.state` would be more appropriate here, `IllegalStateException` vs `IllegalArgumentException`.
Overall looks good. Some minor comments below.

timeline.author: Olga MaciaszekSharma
Olga MaciaszekSharma

timeline.body: Thanks for the updates, and for adding an integration test.
